# HeightField

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/components/rigid_body.h`](../../../src/logic/components/rigid_body.h) · Scene / prefab name: `HeightField` · Described in `data/core.json`

Rolling hills: a static Jolt height field centred on the origin, heights from a sum of plane waves

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `samples` | `int` | per side, a power of 2 >= 8 (256) |
| `spacing` | `float` | metres between samples (0.5) |
| `waves` | `int` | number of plane waves (6) |
| `wavelength` | `glm::vec2` | log-uniform range of the wavelengths, metres (6, 40) |
| `wave_slope` | `float` | steepest slope of each wave, amplitude x wavenumber (0.07) |
| `friction` | `float` | 1 |
| `restitution` | `float` | 0 |
| `seed` | `uint32_t` | wave draw seed; 0: one draw of the WorldRng |
| `wave_list` | `std::vector<HeightField::Wave>` | drawn at creation (k: wave vector on XZ rad/m, amplitude, phase) |
| `body` | `uint32_t` | JPH::BodyID, 0xffffffff until created |

## Notes

height(x, z) is the smooth surface (src/physics/height_field.cpp); the collider is its triangulation. size() = (samples - 1) x spacing.
